model.name: Buttons->Actions + Universal On-Disk Scenarios
model.goal: Convert legacy per-view buttons into universal action-bar actions (R35.1); every item type resolves to a REAL on-disk scenario so both buttons always work (R35.2, extends S34 A2 to all types); scenarios populated with the item's info (R35.3); add traceability as the 4th MDA RawBin folder (R35.4). Builds on S34 universal action bar.

phases.title: Resolver foundation (build FIRST): ensureViewUnit resolves EVERY item type to a real on-disk unit (R35.2) + populates per-type fields at mint (R35.3, same pass). Extends S34 A2, keyToUuid idempotent, prod-untouched, tree byte-unchanged (fork-A).
Traceability as the 4th MDA RawBin folder (R35.4, after foundation): server.ts mofFolder rawbin:traceability + childCount 3->4; expands the REAL trace-tree via existing rb-trace-tree (no fork).

Convert legacy per-view buttons -> universal action-bar actions (R35.1, build LAST): vcard/preview/newtab/proxy -> actionsForContext verbs in the shared universalActionBar; no bespoke button left; no behavior lost.
